description: This file defines and exports column configurations for a React table component displaying model information. It specifies how data should be rendered, sorted, and interacted with within a table, including capabilities for copying data, showing tooltips, and conditional rendering based on model features.

methods.name: formatCapabilityName
methods.description: Converts a support feature key into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getModelCapabilities
methods.description: Filters and retrieves support feature keys that are true for a given model.

methods.name: formatCost
methods.description: Formats a numeric cost into a dollar string with two decimal places.

methods.name: formatTokens
methods.description: Converts token count into a human-readable string with K or M suffix.
